note: Original SVG hardware illustrations, not product photographs or hardware-test evidence. Manufacturer photographs and CAD were consulted for shape/control layout. Distinct example screens use V-Rally 3, Pokémon Ruby / Sapphire, DOOM GBA and Celeste Classic 2 game-frame composites, not device captures. Frame aspect ratios are preserved. The regular display clips only the black padding around the square Celeste gameplay area; other screens use letterboxing. Approximate perspective and comparative sizes, not exact scale.
